files.s: Given an extension of rings `B/A` and an action of `G` on `B`, we introduce a predicate `Algebra.IsInvariant A B G` which states that every fixed point of `B` lies in the image of `A`.

h.d: An action of a group `G` on an extension of rings `B/A` is invariant if every fixed point of `B` lies in the image of `A`.

files.t: Invariant Extensions of Rings and Galois Theory
files.s: Given an extension of rings `B/A` and an action of `G` on `B`, the predicate `Algebra.IsInvariant A B G` states that every fixed point of `B` lies in the image of `A`.

h.d: If the extension `B/Q` over `A/P` is separable, then it is finite dimensional.
If `Q` is a maximal ideal of `B` lying over a maximal ideal `P` of `A`, then the extension `B/Q` over `A/P` is normal.
If the extension `Frac(B/Q)` over `Frac(A/P)` is separable, then it is finite dimensional.
If `Q` is a prime ideal of `B` lying over a prime ideal `P` of `A`, then the extension `Frac(B/Q)` over `Frac(A/P)` is normal.
A variant of `Algebra.isInvariant_of_isGalois`, replacing `Gal(L/K)` by `Aut(B/A)`.
In the AKLB setup, every fixed point of `B` lies in the image of `A`.

(Implementation) The functor taking an open normal subgroup `N ≤ G` to the set of lifts of `σ` in `G ⧸ N`. We will show that its inverse limit is nonempty to conclude that there exists a lift in `G`.
If a ring is an integral domain, then so is its polynomial ring over finitely many variables.
Hilbert basis theorem, that if a ring is Noetherian then so is its polynomial ring.
